newsitem.title: FINLAND: UNIBANK SEES MARKKA SOFT SHORT-TERM.
newsitem.headline: UNIBANK SEES MARKKA SOFT SHORT-TERM.

text.p: Danish Unibank expects the markka to remain soft in short-term and the yield gap over German bunds to continue to trade between 40 and 50 basis points, it said in its weekly report published on Monday.
"We expect the markka to remain soft short term," it said.
"In the week ahead we look for the spread to trade in the 40-50 bp range, primarily at the top end," Unibank said.
Early on Monday, the 10-year yield gap stood unchanged versus Friday at 43 basis points, and the markka was steady at around 3.0025 per mark.
"Owing to the market jitters, Finnish FRA rates may remain at fairly high levels," it added. Long FRA rates had moved higher on forex tensions and uncertainty over EMU, it said.
